claims.sentence: A genuine excerpt does not settle it: in clinical question answering, one model quoted its sources verbatim for 98.0\% of its claims but fully substantiated only 37.1\% \citep{zhang2026verifiable}.
claims.claim: In clinical QA, one model (claude-opus-5) produced verbatim quotes for 98.0% of its claims but fully substantiated only 37.1%.
claims.excerpt: For instance, claude-opus-5 produces verbatim quotes for 98.0% of its claims, but fully substantiates only 37.1%.
claims.location: p. 1, Abstract; see Sec. 4 and Table 1 (pp. 5-6)
claims.note: Supported. Context only: 'verbatim' allows normalized and elided (ellipsis) matches; 'fully substantiated' is decided by an LLM judge; questions are 222 synthetic clinical questions over four guidelines; most of the shortfall is partial support, and 37.1% rises to 85.1% when fresh quotes are sought in the sections the model read.
